title: One-step expansion of a computation
statement: For an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, an oracle language $O$, a choice bit $b$, a finite choice sequence $w$, and a configuration $c$, running on the sequence beginning with $b$ and followed by $w$ gives the same configuration as first taking one step using $b$ and then running on $w$.
